title: Scripture and commentary source register
scope: Identify source-backed, usable digital editions and commentaries for Sanskrit scriptures represented in GRETIL and Muktabodha, including other credible repositories and scans when appropriate.

coverage.method: Manual pilot records only; comprehensive work and edition reconciliation remains pending.

source_inventories.name: GRETIL
source_inventories.notes: Existing legacy Sanskrit download contains overlapping text representations; archive membership is not a count of distinct works.

source_inventories.name: SARIT corpus
source_inventories.status: candidate source; individual records require review

source_inventories.name: Internet Archive
source_inventories.status: candidate source; select and verify individual item and access conditions

workflow: Enumerate source records and preserve source identifiers.
Reconcile works, editions, witnesses and commentaries without merging uncertain matches.
Find direct online text or scan links and compare provenance, completeness, access and accuracy.
Record language, script, format, edition, source, rights, link checks and evidence.
Choose a preferred source only after a documented comparison; record gaps and competing editions.
Independently review representative links, metadata and coverage before claiming completion.

record_conventions.preferred_source: Null until an evidence-backed comparison; not an assertion that a source is universally best.
record_conventions.rights: unknown until checked for this edition and use
record_conventions.commentary: Separate records identify author and work commented on; links remain pending when not established.

open_questions: What constitutes a work versus an edition or representation for coverage reporting?
Which sources and editions can be used for indexing, public display, redistribution and external model processing?
Which commentaries are authoritative or significant within each tradition?
How will access-limited scans and unavailable sources be tracked?
next_steps: Compare a small set of GRETIL and Muktabodha records manually against their original source pages.
Resolve missing direct links and distinguish online access from local copies.
Define and validate the repeatable inventory workflow before scaling.
Add a documented work-by-work backlog and independently check coverage.
